original_value: Do your servers need high-performance Enterprise hard drives for both your mission-critical and I/O intensive applications? HPE Server Enterprise Hard Drives offer the highest level of performance and reliability for your most demanding application workloads. They deliver maximum performance without compromising reliability, specifically engineered to meet the needs of hot data. Enterprise drives help you improve server response times, power more transactions per second and accelerate data transfer (I/O) speeds. HPE Server Enterprise Hard Drives are backed by over 2.4 million hours of the industry’s most rigorous testing and qualification program ensuring customer’s reliable, rugged drives. HPE integrated firmware protects data from malicious attacks that could change or destroy it. result.paraphrase: HPE Server Enterprise Hard Drives are built for mission-critical and I/O-intensive workloads, delivering top-tier performance and reliability for demanding applications. Designed for hot data, they maximize performance without sacrificing dependability, helping improve server response times, increase transactions per second, and speed up I/O data transfer. Backed by more than 2.4 million hours of rigorous industry testing and qualification, these rugged drives are further protected by HPE integrated firmware against malicious attacks that could alter or destroy data. HPE SMART Carrier’s self-describing icons make drive status easy to understand, while the “do not remove” button helps prevent accidental data loss. What’s new: up to 900 GB 15K SAS SFF 512e Enterprise Hard Disk Drives and up to 1.8 TB 10K SAS SFF 512e Enterprise Hard Disk Drives. Ideal for transaction processing, databases, big data analytics, and high-performance computing, this optimized portfolio offers up to 1.8 TB in a smaller footprint and uses the latest 12G SAS interface for better performance. Product description: HPE Enterprise hard drive, 900 GB, SAS 12Gb/s. Type: hot-swap hard drive. Capacity: 900 GB. Form factor: 2.5" SFF. Interface: SAS 12Gb/s. Data transfer rate: 1.2 GBps. Spindle speed: 15000 rpm. Features: advanced format 512n, digitally signed firmware. Dimensions (W x D x H): 3 in x 4.7 in x 0.6 in. Manufacturer warranty: 3 years. Bundled with HPE SmartDrive carrier. Designed for ProLiant DL160 Gen9, DL160 Gen9 Base, DL160 Gen9 Entry, DL160 Gen9 Performance, DL20 Gen9 (2.5"), DL20 Gen9 Base (2.5"), DL20 Gen9 Entry (2.5"), DL20 Gen9 Performance (2.5"), DL20 Gen9 Special Server (2.5"), DL360 Gen9 (2.5"), DL360 Gen9 Base (2.5"), DL360 Gen9 CMS (2.5"), DL360 Gen9 Entry (2.5"), DL360 Gen9 Performance (2.5"), DL360 Gen9 Special Server (2.5"), DL380 Gen9 (2.5"), DL380 Gen9 Base (2.5"), DL380 Gen9 Entry (2.5"), DL380 Gen9 High Performance (2.5"), DL380 Gen9 Performance (2.5"), DL380 Gen9 Special (2.5"), DL580 Gen9 (2.5"), DL580 Gen9 Base (2.5"), DL580 Gen9 Database (2.5"), DL580 Gen9 High Performance (2.5"), ML110 Gen9 (2.5"), ML110 Gen9 Base (2.5"), ML110 Gen9 Entry (2.5"). General: hot-swap hard drive, 900 GB, 2.5" SFF, SAS 12Gb/s, 512 bytes per sector, advanced format 512n, digitally signed firmware, 3 in wide, 4.7 in deep, 0.6 in high, bundled with HPE SmartDrive carrier. Performance: 1.2 GBps external drive transfer rate, 2.72 ms average seek time, 5.36 ms maximum seek time, 0.22 ms track-to-track seek time, 15000 rpm. Expansion & connectivity: 1 x SAS 12 Gb/s interface, compatible with 2.5" SFF bay. Warranty: limited 3-year service and support.
